method: Original closed-bar next-open Runner96h OHLC proxy, stop-first and gap-aware, TP1=1R one third, TP2=1.5R one third, last third trailing at source SL to 96 hours trading candles; no live orders
risk_unit: R = (simulated gross price gain - fixed assumed price cost)/initial stop price distance; not percentage of portfolio capital
reasons_no_new_selection: Not a single one of 16 novel strategy×TF pairs achieved positive net R in BOTH recuts after assumed 1.2 USD/oz cost.
13 were negative both years and 3 had mixed signs. Repeated history is not independent OOS.
One VWAP M15 strategy had 2026 partial +37.031R/PF1.716 but 2025 -32.694R/PF0.780, explicitly reject as cross-year unstable.
Frozen ER20 M30 and SHOCK M15 both still positive and matched prior archived R/operation counts exactly.
All original 10 selected candidate records and historical positive-variants register remain unmodified.
limitations: 2025 and 2026 Q2/Q3 had already been inspected repeatedly, including previous batches; no untouched OOS.
2026 is not a full calendar year.
No broker real ticks, bid/ask, variable spread, swap, commission, slippage, lot rounding, margin, funded equity curve, intratrade drawdown or executed account profits.
VWAP volume is historical OHLCV data, not validated central-exchange gold volume.
Observed 4×4 multiple-testing selection risk. Do not tune losing threshold using same history to claim profitability.
